data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Kynthia, which means 'Moon' or 'Goddess of the Moon'. In Greek mythology, Cynthia was the name of a nymph who was the goddess of the moon. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cindy usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, goddess of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
